'''Mekus Drin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who, following the [[Battle of Asylum]], traveled to [[Odessen]] and joined the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] against the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. She was assigned to the [[Underworld Logistics]] branch of the Alliance under [[Hylo Visz]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mekus Drin appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' expansion as a Bounty Hunter vendor inside [[Alliance base|Odessen base]].<ref name="SWTOR" />
